blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Sunday told protesters not to “tarnish” the country’s reputation amid reports of police arrests and their purported “attacks” during the demonstrations in Liwasang Bonifacio while Manila hosts the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. READ: Protesters, police clash in Manila during Asean Summit protest “At this time, we should stand united.
